entities.summary: Tsering Dorjee Bawa is a Tibetan actor, producer, musician and dancer of Tibetan descent. He acted in the Oscar nominated film ‘Himalaya' in 1999 and has created the original soundtrack with Michael Becker for 2009 Emmy Award-winning documentary ‘The Woman of Tibet - A Quiet Revolution’. He was nominated twice for outstanding featured performance in play, male for his off-Broadway show, 'The Oldest Boy'.
